name: suitApp

sources.title: Homepage — German DACH business-software comparison site, 1,321+ tools, 80+ categories, 50,000+ user reviews
Kontakt — contact form + team@suitapp.de; FAQ: 'Kann ich mein Unternehmen auf suitApp listen? Ja, gerne! Kontaktieren Sie uns...'

requirements: Business software products only — a DACH-focused comparison directory (German-language site, German user reviews, hosting-location data)
No self-serve submission exists: the FAQ says to contact them with details about your software and they 'discuss the possibilities of inclusion'
Site is funded 'über Partnerschaften mit Software-Anbietern' (partnerships with software vendors) — vendor listing may be tied to a partnership/affiliate arrangement
Contact route: /contact form (Anfragetyp options: Allgemeine Frage, Partnerschaft, Business-Anfrage, Presse, Support) or team@suitapp.de; replies claimed within 24h
preparation: Software details: name, URL, category, pricing model, hosting location (DE/EU hosting is a tracked comparison axis)
German-language pitch preferred — the entire site and audience is DACH
Decide your ask: plain listing vs 'Partnerschaft' — use Anfragetyp 'Business-Anfrage' or 'Partnerschaft'
DSGVO/Datenschutz stance helps — the site emphasizes data residency
workflow: Send software details and ask to be listed in the appropriate category
If listed, the product appears as a detail page under /software/<slug>/ within its /kategorien category
watchFor: No published pricing or guaranteed-free listing — 'we discuss possibilities' implies terms are negotiated; expect an affiliate/partnership angle
Site is German-first; English-only vendors targeting non-DACH users are a weak fit
Operator is a sole proprietor in Dresden (Max Benz, per imprint) — a small curated operation
Listings carry editorial-comparison depth (pricing, hosting location, integrations) — inaccurate data will surface in review
countsAsLive: A detail page for the product exists at https://suitapp.de/software/<slug>/ and is reachable from its category page
unknowns: Whether a plain (non-partnership) listing is free
Whether user reviews are solicited or licensed from a third party
